paragraphs: The Alpina B8 has been a mainstay of the 8 Series diesel range since 2012, spanning two generations under one badge. Early G14/G15/G16 models from 2012 to 2015 use the N47, a 2.0-litre diesel that's part of a family known for a specific timing chain issue. From late 2015 onwards, across both the G14/G15/G16 and later the G14/G15/G16, the Alpina B8 switched to the B47, a newer, significantly more reliable unit that doesn't share the N47's timing chain concerns. Knowing which one your car has matters, because the components and the known wear pattern differ - which is exactly why we confirm your exact engine by registration before quoting.
about.boldParagraph: The Alpina B8 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

compatibility.intro: The Alpina B8 uses a specific Alpina-tuned version of the N63 V8. While it shares its foundation with the M850i's N63, the engine control unit (ECU) mapping, turbocharger calibration, and potentially some internal components are Alpina-specific. This means a standard M850i engine is not a direct substitute for an Alpina B8 unit. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:
